prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you want a spray (sunless) tan or a UV tanning bed/booth? And what part of Charlotte are you in (zip code or neighborhood)? If you tell me that I can pull up the highest-rated options near you.

Meanwhile, general guidance and quick recommendations:

- If you want consistency and multiple locations: Palm Beach Tan is a large chain with several Charlotte-area studios; they offer both UV beds and spray options and are good if you want predictable equipment and membership deals.
- If you want a professional airbrush spray tan (best for weddings/events or natural-looking results): search for local independent studios that advertise certified technicians and post before/after photos—look for Mystic Tan, Norvell, or customized airbrush services.
- If you want a quick automated spray: look for salons that offer Mystic/marker-style booths but check reviews—results vary.
- For safety and quality (UV tanning): pick salons with newer beds, regular bulb replacement, staff who perform skin-type consultations, eye and lip protection, and clear hygiene protocols.

How I recommend choosing the “best” salon:
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews (look for comments on staff skill, cleanliness, and consistency).
- Ask what brand/solution they use for spray tans and whether they do a patch test.
- Ask how often UV bulbs are changed and what bed types they have (high-pressure beds give different results from stand-up booths).
- Compare prices for single sessions vs packages/memberships.
- Look at before/after photos and ask about technician experience for airbrush tans.

Tell me your preference and neighborhood and I’ll list the top-rated salons near you with addresses, hours, and contact info.
